name: A Future Task
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Well adventurer... we seem to be at an unfortunate impasse.  We know what we need - the Plates of Uldum - but we have no idea where they might be.  We will research this, and then devise a solid plan of attack.  I have a couple ideas where to start looking; I have high hopes that soon, we'll be asking you to rejoin our efforts to discover the truth.

Sage Truthseeker needs to be informed on this, adventurer; no doubt, he also wants to thank you personally for once again heeding the call.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText:
We're all in agreement then - the best course of action is to wait until we can narrow down the areas where these plates might lie hidden. You've brought us this far adventurer, and I hope you will be the one to head back in to the field to confront the secrets of Uldum.

Allow me to give you this honorarium in the meantime; this should cover any expenses you've encountered in assisting us, and a little something extra. Be sure to check back with us soon... Uldum beckons us all, young one.
